zones.title: Seed
zones.body: Rows live in the Edit Fields nodes as JSON, plus the mock rows of the request body (test identities, gitignored); Split Out makes one item per row; upserts are keyed on the natural key. Run once per environment; safe to re-run (re-seeding restores the two fixture appointments).

panels.title: AR-90 Seed config
panels.body: Markets, codes and prompts are data, not code: a new market is one row, a wording change is one cell. Disclosure texts are placeholders until Legal supplies the market wording. The mock rows in the body (the engagement's test identities, gitignored, sent by ar-seed.py) are upserted after the synthetic fixtures; missing columns are filled from the fixture shape.
